test_semantic_check_cli: test the semantic_check.py CLI by running it with --model-path, --python-embeddings, and --cpp-embeddings arguments
test_cosine_similarity: test the cosine_similarity function to compute cosine similarity between two numpy arrays
test_load_embeddings_from_file: test the load_embeddings_from_file function to load per-token or pooled embeddings from a binary file
test_single_prompt_similarity: test the test_single_prompt_similarity function to compare Python and llama.cpp embedding vectors for a prompt
run_semantic_check_with_prompts_file: run the semantic_check.py CLI with --prompts-file to compare embeddings using prompts from a file
